title: Spreadsheet
description: Read URL rows from a Google Sheet CSV export or another CSV URL. The sheet must allow CSV export with the selected access.

IMPORTER_SHEETS_URL.title: Spreadsheet or CSV URL
IMPORTER_SHEETS_URL.description: A Google Sheets link (including the tab's gid), published CSV link, or direct CSV URL.

IMPORTER_SHEETS_COLUMN.title: URL column
IMPORTER_SHEETS_COLUMN.description: Exact header of the column containing URLs. Reordering rows does not reimport them.

importers_setup.title: Add links to a URL column
importers_setup.description: Use a sheet or CSV with a column named URL. A Title column is optional. Change the column name under Advanced if needed.

importers_setup.title: Paste the sheet or CSV link
importers_setup.description: The URL must allow CSV export. For a private source, select a synced persona under Advanced.

importers_setup.title: Preview new rows
importers_setup.description: Save, then Preview to check the links. Import all archives new rows; later imports skip rows already imported.
importers_setup.image_alt: Seven reading-list links from a real CSV preview, with optional source details collapsed.
